messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take hydrochlorothiazide if you are unable to pass urine (anuria), or if you are allergic to hydrochlorothiazide or to other sulfonamide-derived medicines (sometimes called sulfa drugs).
Before you start HCTZ, tell your doctor if you have or have ever had:
- kidney disease or reduced kidney function
- liver disease, including cirrhosis
- diabetes
- gout or high uric acid levels
- high cholesterol or high triglycerides
- high calcium levels or a parathyroid gland disorder
- low potassium or low sodium levels
- lupus (systemic lupus erythematosus)
- glaucoma
- an allergy to sulfa medicines or to penicillin
Also tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Hydrochlorothiazide may cause jaundice or bleeding problems in a newborn. It can also pass into breast milk and may cause serious side effects in a nursing baby, so you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine or breastfeed.
Triplet: ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has allergy warning", "penicillin"]

The relation 'has allergy warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a known allergic reaction risk in patients with the condition or substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
F. None of the above.
